description: v5 niggle behavior: a recurring niggle is read as a THREAD across weeks and surfaced through a NIGGLE REF ({text, niggle}) inside the 'How you felt' section, echoing the athlete's own words. It must NOT diagnose (tendinitis/ITBS), assess severity, direct care ('monitor', 'rest it', 'ice it', 'stretch it'), or claim a prognosis ('healing', 'getting worse'). The memos behind the thread are listed in sources.memos so the UI can link them. Authored target exemplar — re-record before trusting as baseline.
